capabilities: Render a dashboard in Home.md from Markdown module notes
Track daily focus from a dated note with frontmatter
Surface active project notes and recent vault activity
Quick-capture new notes into a configured input folder
Display a read-only Google Calendar cache on mobile via vault sync
disambiguation: Not an operating system or launcher; it renders a dashboard inside a designated Home.md note from ordinary Markdown notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README says manual verification on physical iPhone, iPad, and Android devices remains pending. Full documentation (privacy model, Google Calendar setup, architecture) lives outside the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboard view that assembles daily focus, projects, journal, captures, and calendar into one Home.md page.

relations.evidence: Google Calendar is optional and requests only calendar.readonly.

requires.name: Google account with Google Cloud project

summary: Dashboard plugin that turns Home.md into a command center with daily focus, active projects, journal, quick capture, inspiration, and optional Google Calendar.
